annotations.title: Status of an order prepared with create_order

description: Returns only the state of the order: awaiting_customer_confirmation, confirming, confirmed_awaiting_payment, paid, expired, cancelled, confirmation_email_failed or needs_assistance. No customer data. Pass the order_id returned by create_order, or the idempotency_key you used.
name: get_order_status

lead_time.description: No firm number of weeks is given by this API: show `url` (the delivery page of brm-chronographes.com, in the user's language) for lead times.

title: Status of an order prepared with create_order
